title: Chicken Alfredo

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.notes: Or as much as makes you happy

steps: Cook chicken separately. You could season it with salt and Italian seasoning if you want. Slice it before or after cooking.
Add pasta, broth, cream and garlic to pot. Simmer until pasta is al dente. Liquid should be mostly absorbed. Add a little extra as needed.
Grate parmesan and add to pasta
